✨ AI Video Generator: 3D FlixAI turns your ideas into AI photos and AI videos in seconds.

🎥🖼️ This all-in-one AI video generator and image generator focuses on three core superpowers: Text to Video, Image to Video and Text to Art. Type anything, add an image or pick a style, and the app instantly creates short videos, anime clips and stunning AI art ready to share.

⭐ MAIN FEATURES
• 🎬 Text to Video
Turn any prompt into short AI videos. Describe a scene, character or story and watch it become a dynamic clip for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and stories. Choose different styles like anime, 3D, cinematic, cartoon or realistic.

• 🖼️➡️🎥 Image to Video
Animate your photos in one tap. Use a selfie, portrait, drawing or any picture and transform it into smooth video with motion, camera moves and magic FX. Perfect for turning simple photos into eye-catching content and creative reels.

• ✏️➡️🎨 Text to Art
Use the AI photo generator to create unique AI images from words. Turn simple text into detailed art, aesthetic wallpapers, anime portraits, 3D-style pictures and creative illustrations for any idea you have.

⚡ SMART, FAST, SIMPLE
• ⚡ One-tap generation for photos and AI videos
• 🎭 Preset styles: anime, 3D, realistic, cartoon, realistic and more
• 📤 High-quality images and videos, ready to download or share
• 👶 Designed to be fast and easy even for complete beginners

🌍 CREATE FOR ANY PLATFORM
Use AI Photos Maker: 3D FlixAI to:
• 🚀 Make viral AI video clips from text or images
• 📖 Tell short stories with AI characters, scenes and motion
• 🧠 Experiment with new concepts, ideas and creative styles

If you’re searching for an video generator, image to video tool or text to art app, AI Video Generator: 3D FlixAI puts everything in one powerful, simple place. ✨
